## Issue Linkage
- Fixes # (default; use when this PR satisfies acceptance criteria and should auto-close the issue)
- Ref # (use only when the issue requires follow-up PRs; add a comment after merge listing remaining acceptance criteria)
- Work is not complete until the issue is closed (auto-closed or manually closed with a completion comment).
- If no issue exists, open one before any work begins.
